ContentType signed via signableHeaders so uploader cannot swap MIME type post-signature. Sec-review HIGH resolved: validators on responseContentDisposition (allows only attachment|inline + quoted safe filename; rejects backslash-quote, traversal, unknown actions) and responseContentType (RFC 6838 subset regex) — blocks stored-XSS via MIME override + filename injection.
